extraction_scope: Source-reviewed worker-5 mechanism ontology from XML sections, figure captions, Table 1 leakage values, supplementary CD/leakage/MD methods, and OA package; placeholder locator note replaced.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Fluorescein-loaded EYPG/EYPC vesicle leakage supports model-membrane permeabilization by the reported AMBP and linear AMP series; this is direct model-membrane evidence and does not by itself prove an intact-cell molecular target.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: bp65, bp67, bp68, bp69, ln65, ln65b, ln69, ln69b
mechanism_claims.limitations: Model vesicle leakage is direct membrane-disruption evidence in lipid vesicles; no live-cell membrane-potential, imaging, or target-binding assay was located.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CD spectra support membrane-mimetic alpha-helical folding for homochiral and mixed-chirality peptides in DPC/TFE conditions, consistent with an amphiphilic membrane-disruption model but not sufficient as a direct killing mechanism.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: bp65, bp69, ln65, ln65b, ln69, ln69b and related analogs reported in Fig. 2/Fig. S3/Table S2
supporting_assay_types: circular dichroism spectroscopy in DPC/TFE membrane-mimetic conditions
mechanism_claims.limitations: CD is direct structural/secondary-structure evidence; mechanism assignment remains bounded to membrane-disruption context supported by leakage assays.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: X-ray crystallography resolved amphiphilic alpha-helical conformations for selected bicyclic and linear analogs, including mixed-chirality examples, providing structural support for the membrane-active design rationale.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: bp65/bp71/Fln65/Fdln69 structural analogs and related AMBP/AMP series
supporting_assay_types: X-ray crystallography of peptide crystals and LecB complexes
mechanism_claims.limitations: Crystallography proves fold/structure in crystals or LecB complexes, not direct antibacterial target engagement.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: MD simulations support helix stability/refolding in DPC micelles and helix bundles for bp65, bp69, ln65, and ln69, but this is computational support rather than experimental mechanism closure.

supplementary_sources: paper_packets/doi__10.1039_d1cb00124h/extracted/supplementary_text/CB-002-D1CB00124H-s001.txt:8.2 MD in the presence of a DPC micelle

mechanism_claims.limitations: Computational-only evidence; not promoted to direct antimicrobial mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: No paper-local evidence was found for a specific intact-cell molecular target, membrane potential assay, microscopy assay, or omics target assignment; mechanism should remain model-membrane disruption plus structural support.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: reported AMBP and linear AMP series
mechanism_claims.limitations: Negative source review statement from checked XML/PDF/supplement/database packet; absence is not converted into a fabricated target.
